items.name: 4af-theme
items.title: 4AF Theme
items.description: The semantic colors, radii, shadows, typography, and motion tokens used by 4AF components.

light.muted-glass: color-mix(in oklab, color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted), black 2%) 92%, transparent)

dark.muted-glass: color-mix(in oklab, color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted), black 12%) 92%, transparent)

.shimmer-text.animate-text-shimmer::afte.background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent calc(50% - var(--text-shimmer-spread, 4ch)), var(--text-shimmer-highlight, color-mix(in oklch, currentColor 45%, white)) 50%, transparent calc(50% + var(--text-shimmer-spread, 4ch)))

items.name: reduced-motion
items.description: Server-safe reduced-motion preference reads and subscriptions.

items.name: numbers
items.description: Shared range clamping and computed CSS length parsing.

items.name: move-focus-outside
items.description: Focus handoff when inline content closes, with optional related-control preference.

items.name: refs
items.description: React 19-safe callback and object ref composition.

items.name: motion
items.description: Duration, easing, spring, and overlay presets, mirroring the CSS motion tokens.

items.name: use-popup-height
items.description: Shared natural-height measurement for smoothly resizing anchored surfaces.

items.name: use-action
items.description: Shared async action feedback with controlled status, separate outcome reset times, hover/focus error holds, and a manual reset that ignores stale results. Outcome callbacks still fire after ordinary unmount; local feedback and timers stop.

items.name: table-of-contents-scroll
items.description: Table-of-contents scroll helpers for endpoint padding, active-entry centering, and overflow-edge affordances.

items.name: table-of-contents-tracking
items.description: Shared heading tracking and click-to-scroll behavior for table-of-contents variants, preserving native modified-click navigation.

items.name: loader
items.description: Small context and loading slot for caller-supplied indicators, with ClassicLoader as the fallback. Hidden Morph sizing copies reserve the indicator footprint without mounting a loader.

items.name: check-mark
items.description: The drawn tick list rows mark their selection with: strokes in when selected, fades out when not.

items.name: button
items.description: Six variants, eight sizes, optical icon alignment, focus-preserving loading, and popup triggers that automatically stay still and retain their open-state styling.

items.name: button-group
items.description: Related Buttons, optionally with Input, Select, AlignedSelect, SearchSelect, and DatePicker fields, joined horizontally or vertically, with flattened inner corners and variant-specific seams. Each control keeps its own tab stop.

items.name: field
items.description: A labelled form field on Base UI's Field and Fieldset: the label marks required controls with * or optional ones with "(optional)", read from the control's own required attribute; descriptions, animated errors (including server error lists), a validity status mark, horizontal control rows, and fieldsets and groups that set the marker convention for every field inside.

items.name: input
items.description: A Base UI input with automatic native validation styling, a character counter, optional leading icon and trailing action, accessible descriptions, number steppers, and default, plain, and underline variants.

items.name: separator
items.description: An accessible horizontal or vertical hairline with rich labels, alignment, and decorative mode, built on Base UI Separator.

items.name: scroll-area
items.description: A scroll container that draws its own thin scrollbar, the same in every browser, shown on hover and scroll or always, with edge fades on by default. Base UI Scroll Area behaviour.

items.name: textarea
items.description: A Base UI multiline field with animated auto-growing row limits, automatic validation styling, optional Ctrl/Command+Enter submission, descriptions, and manual resizing when auto-grow is off.

items.name: alert
items.description: An inline status message with optional title, description, custom or hidden icons, and controlled or uncontrolled dismissal. Supports custom rendering and the shared loading indicator.

items.name: toggle
items.description: A button with a persistent pressed state, independent icon and background fills, custom rendering, and state-aware styling.

items.name: morph
items.description: Animated content swap — icons or text. Copy to check, Follow to Following. Hidden sizing copies reserve loader space without mounting animated indicators.

items.name: delete-button
items.description: A destructive button that arms on the first press and confirms on the second, with Escape, blur, and timeout exits. Parent updates preserve the armed timeout.

items.name: copy-button
items.description: Copies to the clipboard and confirms it visually and to screen readers, preserving keyboard focus while pending.

items.name: action-button
items.description: Internal or controlled async feedback with pending/success/error, separate reset times, errors held while hovered or focused, and rejection-based labels. Preserves focus while pending, with stable or animated width and custom loading indicators.

items.name: action-toggle
items.description: An async toggle with independent controlled feedback, rejection-based labels, errors held while hovered or focused, and a feedback reset that preserves pressed state and ignores late results. Keeps keyboard focus while pending.

items.name: tabs
items.description: Horizontal or vertical segment, pill, and underline tabs with automatic scrolling, icons, counts, custom panels, and an indicator visible before hydration.

items.name: switch
items.description: A draggable switch with optimistic async saving, delayed shared loaders, failure rollback, optional on/off marks, invalid styling, custom rendering, and state-aware classes. Retains its stretching thumb and adaptive or fixed tone.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: An animated checkbox with shared group values, select-all parents, nested groups, validation styling, and custom rendering.

items.name: radio
items.description: A radio group with a white selection ring and open center, custom rendering, state-based classes, and Field validation styling.

items.name: slider
items.description: A horizontal or vertical slider with bar, knob, and circle variants, optional whole-range dragging, editable values, formatted tooltips, custom spoken values, and a customizable root. Base UI behaviour with spring motion and a custom fill colour.

items.name: scrub-slider
items.description: A card-shaped number scrubber: drag along a ruler whose ticks lift around the indicator, with an edge zone that keeps scrolling for long ranges; click to type a value, or nudge it with chevrons. Label and dimmed unit inside, card or outline-ghost style, and Base UI keyboard, ARIA, and form behaviour.

items.name: progress
items.description: Accessible progress bars, stacked segments, and circular rings with custom colors, indeterminate states, and composable label and value parts.

items.name: badge
items.description: A status badge with four appearances, optional neutral text, icons or pulsing dots, animated counts, removable tags, custom rendering, and truncation or wrapping.

items.name: number-animation
items.title: Number Animation
items.description: Rolling numbers with motion blur, locale-aware formatting, and reduced-motion support.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: Pulsing placeholders with content-sized loading wrappers, a ready-state fade, inline rendering, and text lines that follow surrounding typography. Square corners by default; reduced motion disables animations.

items.name: collapsible
items.description: A Base UI disclosure with gap-aware height transitions, custom trigger icons, state-based styling, and content clipping during motion.

items.name: table
items.description: A semantic table with pinned columns and headers, wrapping text, cell alignment, automatic surface backgrounds, loading skeletons, and empty states. Install data-table for selection, sorting, and row actions.

items.name: data-table
items.description: A data table with search, filtering, pagination, column visibility, multi-column sorting, selection, and row actions.

items.name: table-of-contents
items.description: A table of contents that tracks visible headings, keeps the last passed section active through long prose, and offers spanning or single-heading markers.

items.name: table-of-contents-lines
items.description: A line-based table of contents with a longer rule per heading, shorter content rules between headings, and a highlighted, expanding hover treatment.

items.name: empty
items.description: A composable empty state with compact sizing, an optional staggered entrance, custom elements, and wrapping rich descriptions. Borderless by default with an optional dashed outline.

items.name: text-shimmer
items.description: A color-aware highlight across text, looping or once, with an active switch, responsive controls, native props and refs. Static under reduced motion.

items.name: scramble-text
items.description: A short random-character reveal for text that is appearing or changing, with whitespace preservation and reduced-motion support.

items.name: blur-text
items.description: Text that blurs and rises into place by whole Unicode characters or words. Uses Intl.Segmenter when available to preserve combined emoji and accents. CSS only, shown at once under reduced motion.

items.name: select
items.description: Single or multiple selection with named sections, optional search, nested options, and footer actions. Supports state-based classes, Field error styling, and custom popup containers and alignment offsets.

items.name: command-palette
items.description: A keyboard-first command and search palette with nested panels, custom panel content, fuzzy filtering, async/server-driven and paginated search, keybind hints, panel tab bars with Tab/Shift+Tab switching, and Base UI dialog/autocomplete behavior.

items.name: kbd
items.description: Keyboard keycaps and groups with automatic platform labels, key sequences, shared sizes, context-aware colors, and custom icon sizing. Shared by Command Palette, Dropdown Menu, and Sidebar.
items.title: Kbd

items.name: ascii-loader
items.description: A looping braille spinner for compact async status affordances, with optional loading visibility that stops its timer while hidden.

items.name: matrix-loader
items.description: A 4×4 matrix dot loader with scan, twinkle, size variants, and optional loading visibility.

items.name: classic-loader
items.description: Twelve fading radial bars adapted from loading.dev, with CSS-only motion, size variants, speed control, and optional loading visibility.

items.name: select-aligned
items.description: A single-select menu aligned with the selected option, with searchable sections, state-based classes, Field error styling, and custom popup containers and positioning.

items.name: select-search
items.description: A searchable single or multi-select with filtered sections, state-based classes, Field error styling, and custom popup containers and positioning. The input fits its placeholder and the panel grows to its longest row.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: Hover and focus hints with cursor tracking, shared popups, controlled visibility, disabled states, long-content wrapping, composable parts, and state-aware styling.

items.name: selection-toolbar
items.description: A floating toolbar for selected text, with action buttons, async actions, and toggles.

items.name: sheet
items.description: A viewport-aware edge panel with content-sized top and bottom sheets, customizable panel and backdrop, Base UI Dialog behavior, and Motion enter/exit.

items.name: dialog
items.description: A centered Base UI modal with a separately scrolling body, nested layers, shared trigger payloads, composable surfaces, and validated multi-step flows.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.description: A confirmation dialog with shared Dialog layout, async actions, automatic Cancel focus, keyboard action navigation, optional media, and configurable outside dismissal.

items.name: date-picker
items.description: Single-date, multiple-date, and date-range fields with a popover and consistent sizing on every device, medium or numeric date labels, and a standalone Calendar with a month / year picker.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.description: A composable breadcrumb trail with separator styles, sibling-page menus, and middle items collapsed into a dropdown or an animated in-place expansion.

items.name: popover
items.description: An interactive anchored panel with smooth content resizing, Scroll Area overflow, shared trigger payloads, and composable popup parts.

items.name: hover-card
items.description: A hover and focus preview with smooth resizing, Scroll Area overflow, stable placement, shared trigger payloads, and loading placeholders.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.description: A Base UI menu with shared trigger payloads, wrapping rows, state-based styling, portal and positioning options, async actions, and searchable nested selection panels.

items.name: context-menu
items.description: A right-click and long-press menu anchored at the pointer, with touch hold feedback, a disabled mode that keeps the browser menu, and every Dropdown Menu row, panel, and composable popup part.
items.title: Context Menu

items.name: menubar
items.description: A desktop-style bar of Dropdown Menus with arrow-key and pointer sweeping between menus, a sliding open-menu highlight, instant panel switching, outline or plain bars, two sizes, and vertical layout.
items.title: Menubar

items.name: sidebar
items.description: A responsive sidebar with split layouts, configurable scoped shortcuts, mobile close-on-navigation, count and dot badges, hover-replacement actions, collapsible rows, and loading skeletons.

items.name: sidebar-layout
items.description: An optional viewport shell composing Sidebar with independently scrolling content, a surface-colored header with a title or custom content, header actions, and a left-aligned collapse trigger.
